name: Big Mac Salad Bowl (Cheeseburger in a Bowl)

fit.note: 491 cal within 400-650; 9g carbs well under 35g; no seafood; brown-beef skillet + weigh-and-divide bowl scales cleanly.

dupe_check.reason: Distinct from cheeseburger-rice-bowls (93-7 ground beef + cheddar + ketchup cooked over rice) and cheeseburger-pasta (penne bake): this is a cold-assembled special-sauce salad over shredded lettuce with no cooked starch, different sauce profile (mayo-ketchup-relish Big Mac sauce vs plain cheeseburger seasoning) and different method (raw bowl assembly vs skillet). Only protein+cheddar overlap (1-2 of 4 axes); starch, sauce, and method all diverge. No Big Mac / cheeseburger-salad bowl exists in the beef catalog.

cross_protein_collisions: A ground-turkey or ground-chicken 'Big Mac / cheeseburger salad bowl' would be structurally the same plate (special sauce + lettuce + cheddar + pickles, protein swapped) - decider should check turkey/chicken pools for a burger-salad twin.
Also watch for a generic 'burger bowl' or 'bunless cheeseburger bowl' in any protein lane.
